ria.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Standards for Heavy-Duty Vehicles: Phase 3 - Regulatory Impact Analysis
ria.scope: Cover, battery-deterioration referral and section-3.4.7.6 cost-method text before Table 3-81. Tables, model files and other cost chapters are not audited.

recycling-referral.locator: Complete section 4.7 Response before section 4.8 Safety.

mineral-availability.locator: Section 17.2 Response: Availability of the critical minerals, through the sentence before Response: Sufficiency of Battery Production on PDF 1681.

mineral-security-recycling.locator: Paragraph beginning Recycling is also a part of the solution through the conclusion preceding the human-rights response.

reviews.basis: MEMA's request is reproduced twice and summarized by name. The recycling response refers to broader analysis, and the mineral-security paragraphs discuss recycling supply and funding. These passages do not establish addition of the requested recycling/disposal costs. The RIA explicitly reports a different addition: battery-replacement and ICE-rebuild purchaser costs.

The collective response acknowledges uncertainty, rejects projected mineral-shortfall objections and cites a new ANL analysis. The final preamble adds BMI lithium scenarios with project-stage weighting. This partly aligns with the requested method changes, but does not verify the full scaling/confidence/sensitivity request or attribute changes to MEMA.

analysisComparisons.basis: Recycling as a mineral source and recycling funding were already discussed at proposal. RIA section 3.4.7.6 describes newly added replacement/rebuild purchaser costs; neither this nor a funding announcement verifies the requested recycling/disposal cost input.

EPA describes expanded lithium analysis and BMI weighted/unweighted scenarios. ANL supplies explicit utilization and project-timing assumptions, but lists uncertainty sensitivities as future work. Forecast ranges are not established statistical confidence levels, realized supply, or MEMA-caused changes.

sourceCautions.finding: A documented replacement-cost addition is not the requested recycling/disposal addition.
sourceCautions.handling: Keep the latter unverified within scope; do not code acceptance, rejection or docket-wide nonresponse.

sourceCautions.finding: EPA's BMI scenarios differ from ANL's assumptions and future-work statement. Figure II-2 uses thousands of tonnes, with mined lithium labeled contained lithium carbonate equivalent (LCE); Figure II-3 uses GWh-equivalent demand and conditional maximum recycling.
sourceCautions.handling: Do not combine the figure values, attribute BMI weighting to ANL, convert scenarios into confidence intervals, or treat projected capacity as realized production.

sourceCautions.finding: ANL's title page dates the report February 2024; the response cites March. RIA page 259 refers to 3.4.6.5, while the inspected replacement-cost heading is 3.4.7.6 on page 547.
sourceCautions.handling: Record the source variants and inspected page locations; do not silently repair citations or infer different substantive analyses.

boundary.comparisonBoundary: Historical documentary coding only. Source-method changes and thematic responses do not identify an individual comment's effect or justify simulator parameter calibration.
boundary.unreviewedAnalysis: No complete cost-input/model audit, full ANL replication, direct BMI source review, full section-17.2 review or realized-production comparison. Nonverification is scoped, not proof that a cost is absent everywhere.
